reasons: Cited Section 18.1–18.2 matches the playbook preferred position on every material term: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, term plus one year at Vendor's expense, and certificates on request.
Employer's liability USD 1M and the insurer/notice/non-limitation provisions in 18.2 are additions favourable to Customer, so no redline is warranted.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was rendered (redline text is identical to the original) and no comment was added; deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
